value: Fernhollow Journeys plans trips to the Isle of Carrow, Mirelake, the Brannock Highlands and Port Ellery.
Crossings to the Isle of Carrow are run by the Carrow Ferry Company from Mirelake harbour and, in winter from Friday to Monday, from Port Ellery.
Trip TR-4471 is for two adults staying at the Carrow Harbour Inn.
Trip TR-4588 is a family of four with two children aged 6 and 9.
After trip TR-4390 the traveller said the Brannock Lodge was cold and asked for a warmer hotel next time.
Travel insurance is the traveller's own choice; the desk notes on the trip file whether the traveller has a policy but never sells one.
The planning desk is staffed 08:00 to 18:00, Monday to Friday.
The assistant can only read bookings; the desk makes changes within one working day.
Regional trains link Mirelake, the Brannock Highlands and Port Ellery; there is no rail on the Isle of Carrow.
The winter ferry timetable runs from 1 November 2026 to 31 March 2027.
On the Isle of Carrow a local bus meets every daytime ferry at the harbour.
The Carrow Harbour Inn has no parking; car travellers park at the harbour car park.
A trip is confirmed once the deposit of 20 percent is paid; the balance is due 14 days before departure.
Trip TR-4602 is an anniversary trip; the traveller asked for a sea-view room.
